title: Princess Polly Giselle Midi Dress (Orange)

comparisons.notes: Same Giselle midi dress in Orange (cowl neckline, cut-out sides, fit and flare) listed at $85 on Princess Polly's US store with sizes US 0-12 offered.

writeup: Princess Polly's Giselle midi dress in orange is $18.99 new on Woot. It has a cowl neckline, cut-out sides, crossover adjustable straps, an exposed back and a fit-and-flare skirt. Princess Polly's own US store lists the same dress at $85, and Woot allows up to 10 per customer.
